dedupe_keys.name: interpolating ground motion intensity at sites in the next generation liquefaction database

description: Interpolating Ground Motion Intensity at Sites in the Next Generation Liquefaction Database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ellen Rathje, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). This project creates an algorithm for estimating ground motion intensity at liquefaction sites caused by earthquakes. The data and methods used in this project can be applied to any liquefaction site around the world to predict ground motion intensity. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-ab8v-z026. Keywords: Liquefaction, Next Generation Liquefaction, Christchurch, Ground Motion Intensity, Peak Ground Acceleration. Published 2021-08-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
